## Track one base at a time {#worked}

Simplify $\displaystyle\frac{(3x^2y)^2}{6xy^3}$. Predict the numerator, then reveal the steps in order.

<details name="worked-working">
<summary>1. Expand the power</summary>

$(3x^2y)^2=3^2x^{2\times2}y^2=9x^4y^2$. The power applies to all three factors.

</details>

<details name="worked-working">
<summary>2. Divide the coefficients and like bases</summary>

$\dfrac{9x^4y^2}{6xy^3}=\dfrac32 x^{4-1}y^{2-3}=\dfrac32 x^3y^{-1}$. The denominator contains one more factor of $y$ than the numerator.

</details>

<details name="worked-working">
<summary>3. Write the result with positive indices</summary>

$y^{-1}=1/y$, so $\dfrac32 x^3y^{-1}=\dfrac{3x^3}{2y}$.

</details>
